pageCache.pageTitle: Mulberry Academy St Leonards - Holding Page
pageCache.text:
Welcome to Mulberry Academy St Leonards
Mulberry Academy St Leonards is proud to be part of the Mulberry Schools Trust family.
On 1 March 2026, The St Leonards Academy was renamed following the transfer of the school to the Mulberry Schools Trust.
Our new website is currently under development and will be available later in the summer term.
Until the new website is live, please continue to access school information via the existing website:
For further information about the Mulberry Schools Trust, please visit www.mulberryschoolstrust.org
Mulberry Academy St Leonards is part of the Mulberry Schools Trust which is a charitable company limited by guarantee registered in England and Wales (Company No. 10035860). Company’s registered office: Mulberry Schools Trust, Richard Street, Commercial Road, London E1 2JP. Tel: 020 7790 6327.
